'''Heavy-Lifting Weighted Legs''' were bipedal locomotion parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] built by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Made of gray cast-[[Iron/Legends|iron]], [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]], and high-[[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] [[Steel/Legends|steel]], the magnetic and highly-durable legs were designed for heavy duty [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] units. They weighed 37 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and were equipped with the walking, jumping, and running ability. They had a low [[Battery/Legends|battery]] usage.
